lines.1: 「Hey, Otome. Where'd Leo go? He didn't come wake me up today, and he wasn't home either.」
lines.2: 「He called last night in a hoarse voice. He said he was at a friend's place and would be home late.」
lines.3: 「But he still hasn't come back. As his sister, I'm worried...」
lines.4: 「A friend's place? And he hasn't come home? That sounds really suspicious.」
lines.6: 「Today, after Yoshimi, Tsushima is absent as well.」
lines.9: 「We received word that Yoshimi is absent due to illness.」
lines.15: 「This class... rotten in very good way.」
lines.16: 「Princess, have you heard anything from Yoppi?」
lines.17: 「Mm. She emailed me, so I know it's just a cold. That was a relief.」
lines.20: 「Tsushima-kun went to check on her yesterday.」
lines.42: 「Ngh... What the heck are they doing?」
lines.45: 「Oh, I got an email from Yoppi.」
lines.46: "Don't worry about me. I'll explain everything properly on Sunday or so, so until then, please just leave me alone."
lines.48: 「Princess! Where does Yoppi live? I'm going over there.」
lines.49: 「She's only missed two days. Don't make such a fuss.」
lines.51: 「What? Is that what has you so worried, Crab?」
lines.53: 「Then let's just wait and see until the weekend.」
